title: Visibility
description: When the overlay is shown: during gameplay only, also on the results screen, or always

title: Scroll direction
description: auto follows the osu!mania skin/setting scroll direction; up and down override it for every mode

title: Scroll speed
description: auto uses the game's mania scroll speed; otherwise 1-40 on the osu! scroll speed scale (constant real-time speed, independent of DT/HT)

title: Input offset (ms)
description: auto adds lazer's universal audio offset (scaled by the playback rate) so presses line up with notes; a number overrides it in gameplay milliseconds

title: Fade out notes and presses
description: Notes and presses lose opacity as they approach the far edge

title: Show keys
description: EZ2ON-style key boxes with key names and press counts at the judgement edge

title: Show notes (mania)
description: Draw the map's elapsed notes under the presses in mania: native maps and osu!standard converts, including key mods, Dual Stages, Hold Off, Invert, Mirror and lazer Random (stable Random has no readable seed, so it shows presses only)

title: Maximum lane width (px)
description: Lanes shrink to fit the overlay width but never grow past this

title: Renderer
description: webgl2 (default) renders everywhere; webgpu tries WebGPU first and falls back to WebGL2 when it is unavailable or reports errors (WebGPU canvases currently fail inside vosulay on NVIDIA/Linux)
